Abstract

1. Introduction

Feature upsampling is a crucial ingredient in dense prediction models for gradually recovering the feature resolution. The most commonly used upsamplers are nearest neighbor (NN) and bilinear interpolation, which follows fixed rules to interpolate upsampled values. To increase flexibility, learnable upsamplers are introduced in some specific tasks, e.g., deconvolution in instance segmentation [13] and pixel shuffle [34] in image super-resolution [31, 12, 22].

*Corresponding author

However, they either suffer from checkerboard artifacts [32] or seem not friendly to high-level tasks. With the popularity of dynamic networks [14], some dynamic upsamplers have shown great potential on several tasks. CARAFE [37] generates content-aware upsampling kernels to upsample the feature by dynamic convolution. The following work FADE [29] and SAPA [30] propose to combine both the high-res guiding feature and the low-res input feature to generate dynamic kernels, such that the upsampling process could be guided by the higher-res structure. These dynamic upsamplers are often of complicated structures, require customized CUDA implementation, and cost much more inference time than bilinear interpolation. 学习通过学习采样进行上采样    

刘文泽, 陆浩, 傅洪涛, 曹志国; Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2023, pp. 6027-6037

摘要

我们提出了DySample，一种超轻量级且有效的动态上采样器。虽然最近基于核的动态上采样器，如CARAFE、FADE和SAPA，展现了令人印象深刻的性能提升，但它们引入了大量的计算负担，主要归因于耗时的动态卷积以及用于生成动态核的额外子网络。此外，FADE和SAPA对高分辨率特征引导的需求在某种程度上限制了它们的应用场景。为了解决这些问题，我们绕过了动态卷积，并从点采样的角度构建上采样，这种方法更节省资源，并且可以轻松地使用PyTorch中的标准内置函数实现。我们首先展示了一个朴素的设计，然后逐步演示如何加强其上采样行为，最终得到我们新的上采样器DySample。与先前的基于核的动态上采样器相比，DySample不需要定制的CUDA包，并且参数量、FLOPs、GPU内存和延迟都更少。除了轻量级的特性外，DySample在五个密集预测任务上优于其他上采样器，包括语义分割、目标检测、实例分割、全景分割和单目深度估计。代码可在https://github.com/tiny-smart/dysample处获取。
